split_policy.cross_subject_duplicates: If present, LOSO handling must be decided explicitly after this audit; subject boundaries must not be silently overridden.
split_policy.known_signer: Every exact numeric duplicate group is indivisible and must remain wholly within one partition.
split_policy.singleton_samples: Each nonduplicate recording receives its own singleton split_group_id.
split_policy.target_conflicts: If present, conflicting duplicate groups require explicit review before any split generation.
